evidence.static_summary: Current host/native/build evidence and original dated results are recorded in EVIDENCE.json.
evidence.manual_summary: User report on 2026-11-02 for Eden: "hmm, please do better and modern weapon controls works perfectly, promote them to ready to distribute." Installed NRO 84902446e37c6abbd41516a751e66d0adb76262c9531bcf642664095979a8c32 is the r25 payload. The Eden log of that day (sha256 d386dbe0e15b1bc82fdbace945a673237e395e51c5f11af341d3603a6c53328e, master-7a6d055094) has no line naming this plugin, which logs nothing in normal operation, so the report is tied to these bytes by the installed hash. Weapons, styles, screens and platforms were not itemized.

limitations: Gameplay evidence for r25 is one unitemized user report on Eden (2026-11-02). Ryujinx and native Switch coverage remain unconfirmed.
Individual player-page quantity, Palico exclusion, appraisal/collection, persistence and consecutive-quest checks were not separately reported.
Log contains HLE/keyboard and Maxwell assertions plus an unmapped-memory error; no clean-run or clean-shutdown claim. These emulator messages are not attributed to the plugin.
Native inventory capacity and the 150-entry appraisal queue remain; unsupported records or quantity products above 32767 suppress the entire multiplier attempt.
Ryujinx and physical Switch gameplay are untested.
Successful cache calls do not establish CPU translation freshness; the second forced check broader role remains incompletely traced.
reason: r25, the Rust/forge-rs rewrite, approved for distribution after the user reported it working on Eden. Promoted unchanged from its candidate.
target: MHGU Nintendo Switch 1.4.0; upstream Forge 1.5.1; Eden/Ryujinx.
